content.text: I reproduced seven functional failures using in-memory mocks, without touching credentials or settings files. I also found adapters outside the documented source exception. The review covers all 55 changed or untracked files; checks and builds pass, but they do not catch these account, permission, collector, and history issues.

Found **8 issues**: one P1 and seven P2s.

1. **[P1] Credential readers exceed the approved source boundary.** [server.mjs:87](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/subset/apps/usage/server.mjs:87) enables Cursor, Devin, and stored-login adapters that read credentials and call undocumented endpoints. The exception in [AGENTS.md:72](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/subset/AGENTS.md:72) permits this only for Claude Code and Factory Droid. Other providers need approved documented interfaces.

2. **[P2] Turning local sign-ins off still reads credential stores.** [server.mjs:281](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/subset/apps/usage/server.mjs:281) calls all four stored-login readers without checking preferences. Opening **Add account** triggers this endpoint even with the setting disabled. Reproduced with mocked readers.

3. **[P2] A custom default Claude directory reads the wrong sign-in.** [claude.ts:37](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/subset/packages/usage/src/claude.ts:37) removes `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` when it equals the host’s default—even when that default came from a custom environment override. The CLI then reads its normal default directory. The live reader also selects the default keychain service. Preserve the configured directory throughout.

4. **[P2] Cached Claude usage gets attributed to a new account.** [server.mjs:103](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/subset/apps/usage/server.mjs:103) caches by profile ID, then overwrites the cached result’s identity with current auth information. Switching sign-ins within five minutes shows account A’s quota under account B’s email. Reproduced; cache entries need identity validation.

5. **[P2] Harness fallback overrides an explicit access denial.** [server.mjs:145](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/subset/apps/usage/server.mjs:145) treats a blocked Codex account as eligible for fallback, replaces its state with `ok`, and clears its errors. `ordinaryUsageAllowed` remains false, producing contradictory structured status and hiding the Limited badge. Reproduced; preserve authoritative denial state.

6. **[P2] Replacing an Antigravity collector loses the original status line.** [accounts.mjs:457](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/subset/apps/usage/accounts.mjs:457) discards another collector’s command without inheriting its saved predecessor. Install collector A over an existing status line, install B, then uninstall B: `statusLine` is deleted instead of restored. The backup is also overwritten. Reproduced with an in-memory filesystem.

7. **[P2] One failed provider read deletes historical usage.** [history.ts:44](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/subset/packages/usage/src/history.ts:44) retains history only for currently returned windows. A temporary unavailable result with `windows: []` erases that account’s entire history; temporarily omitted Claude windows have the same problem. Reproduced. Preserve prior series until retention expiry or explicit removal.

8. **[P2] Concurrent requests bypass the single-sign-in guard.** [accounts.mjs:540](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/subset/apps/usage/accounts.mjs:540) checks for an active connection before awaiting `profiles()`, but reserves the connection afterward. Two simultaneous requests both become pending. Reproduced; serialize startup or reserve the active slot before awaiting.

Reviewed **7 modified tracked files and 48 untracked files**, including contracts, callers, tests, configuration, and documentation. There are no staged changes or commits ahead of the recorded upstream.

Validation passed: workspace checks, non-emitting TypeScript/Svelte checks, **75 focused tests**, and current-source frontend builds performed entirely in memory. Tests requiring filesystem writes and live provider/browser checks were not run. No files, credentials, settings, or Git state were changed.

content.text: The original eight findings are resolved in the scenarios reported. I found related account-identity gaps plus new CLI and release issues, with mocked reproductions confirming the runtime cases. All 63 reviewed file hashes still match the starting snapshot.

Found five actionable issues:

1. **[P1] Manual releases can publish a different commit from the requested tag.** [publish-tag.yml:30](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/subset/.github/workflows/publish-tag.yml:30) checks out the dispatch ref, while `release_tag` only selects and validates the package version. Dispatching from `main` can publish untagged changes under an existing release version. Checkout and verify the requested tag before building.

2. **[P2] Old Claude snapshots can be attributed to a newly signed-in account.** [server.mjs:113](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/subset/packages/usage-cli/src/server.mjs:113) adds the current auth email to previously collected quota. After switching accounts, disabling local sign-ins or losing live credentials returns the old account’s windows under the new email. A mocked reproduction confirmed this. Bind snapshots to the observed identity or invalidate them when identity changes.

3. **[P2] Cache identity checks remain incomplete.** [server.mjs:107](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/subset/packages/usage-cli/src/server.mjs:107) uses an empty identity when a stored login lacks an email. Replacing that login still returns the previous quota for two minutes; account IDs, token changes, and sign-out flags are ignored. Other provider caches also remain keyed only by profile. Validate the current credential state before cache reuse and use a stable account identity.

4. **[P2] Separate profile configurations overwrite each other’s collector shim.** [server.mjs:208](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/subset/packages/usage-cli/src/server.mjs:208) uses one shim per data directory but embeds the active profiles-file path. Starting configuration B overwrites the shim already installed for A, redirecting A’s collectors to B’s profiles. A mocked reproduction confirmed the overwrite. Give each configuration its own shim or preserve its binding in the collector command.

5. **[P2] The advertised read-only `status` command persists configuration.** [server.mjs:84](/Users/serro/Documents/dev/n/subset/packages/usage-cli/src/server.mjs:84) calls `ensureDefaultClaude()`, which writes an automatically discovered profile. Keep discovery transient for `status`, or reserve persistence for an explicit account operation.
